correction: System preparation creates owners then acquires each WRITE lease, writes/reads payload and releases the lease. N_OWNERS_NO_LEASES describes the completed preparation checkpoint and timed owner-release phase only; it does not describe all preparation.
release_phase_scope: Timed release does not acquire or release leases. For the lease-only55candidate its owner lookup remainedstdmap, so lease-table hashing/backshift is not timed release work; preparation does exercise lease storage. This exclusion must not be transferred to the fused890candidate, whose owner table has changed.
